reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Pacific Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprise (MSME) Finance Project

description.narrative: The project is designed to stimulate economic growth in four small Pacific island countries by (i) providing a state-owned bank in each country with additional capital to enable it to increase its lending to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs); (ii) strengthening the management capacities and IT systems of the banks so that they can operate on a more commercial basis and provide a full range of financial services to the population, including those located on islands other than the main island; and (iii) improving the business skills of MSME entrepreneurs so that they are able to access credit on reasonable terms and conditions. The project is also designed to produce regional benefits through increased trade and information and knowledge sharing among the stakeholders in the participating countries.
